reproduction.actual: Current goal declaration receives deployment capability-effect identities/guidance, and validator repair feedback can prescribe replacement dependency/decomposition values. Exact post-freeze matching therefore depends on capability-shaped pre-freeze semantics and does not have a capability-independent requested-output join.
reproduction.expected: Before FrozenSemanticContract is accepted, exactly one Semantic Writer owns semantic values and receives capability-independent domain meaning only; validators may reject but never supply replacement semantic answers.

violated_invariants: Only the goal-declaration writer may create semantic values before freeze.
Pre-freeze model input must not disclose tool/capability availability, capability identities, planning contracts, discovery examples, or exclusion examples.
Semantic validators may return PASS/REJECT/CLARIFY with grounded violations but may not provide replacement requested-effect, dependency, target, or Goal-decomposition values.
Capability execution authority must be derived after freeze from exact machine-checkable semantic output coverage; no exact coverage means no execution.
